title: events/types/legacy.unmapped
description: Payload for event_type 'legacy.unmapped': catch-all for upstream bus.py kinds with no registered mapping (FR-008). Shape {kind, data} preserves the raw upstream kind and data verbatim — stored, but rejected by strict execution consumers (code event.type.not_executable). Permissive by design: the point is store-not-execute.

kind.description: Raw upstream kind value, preserved verbatim.

data.description: Raw upstream data dict, preserved verbatim and unvalidated.
